raw_market.question: Illinois vs. Michigan State: 4Q O/U 16.5
raw_market.description:
In the fourth quarter of the college football game between Illinois and Michigan State, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Illinois and Michigan State combine to score 17 or more points in the fourth quarter.

If the combined fourth quarter total is less than 17, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
